description: Closes a pact; requests still waiting on it are declined. Running deals keep their terms. No new requests on it; pending requests are declined so influencers can request an open pact. Accepted and running deals keep their terms. Closing a closed pact changes nothing.

api_key.description: Studio API key. Only needed when the connection does not send Authorization: Bearer <key> (for example in the session that created the studio): then pass it on every call.

name: close_pact
title: Close pact
